_about: Curated WorldQuant BRAIN Fast Expression operator signatures. Signature syntax: name(param:kind[=default], *variadic:kind) [-> returns]. Kinds: matrix, vector, group, lookback (positive integer constant), int, number, string, bool. Parameters with a default are optional and should be passed by keyword. Availability depends on your BRAIN level: if the platform rejects an operator, set "unavailable": true on it.
